scope: CPU actual Three projection matrices/RenderTarget ownership and renderer-state control; no browser/GPU/source-floor/real-world visual acceptance
checks: actual perspective projection maps source window corners to all four viewport corners
head parallax preserves source aperture coordinates while depths move differently
near clipping excludes the retained source facade and keeps immediately exterior geometry
bad side, degenerate/skew corners, nonfinite values and inadequate far are rejected without changing camera or inputs
portrait, ultrawide, high-DPR and tiny targets remain within exact pixel/dimension caps
one bounded target calls the existing-world renderer once and restores all renderer state
exceptions, recursive calls and asynchronous callbacks still restore existing world state
resize releases are bounded and final disposal is idempotent without owning the renderer or prior target
actual room ownership snapshot never adopts the external portal texture, before or after attachment
